decisions.reason: Garage door operators are presented on a dedicated page and sit at the core of the firm's one-source garage system offering, so the visible commitment and investment favor persistence.

The solid wood sectional door is only mentioned and is a niche variant with modest visible commitment, but it fits the customization promise and has had too little time on the market to be judged a failure.
The remote-control operator is only mentioned yet complements the featured operator line, so dropping it would undercut the operator investment the firm has made.
This glazed industrial door is only mentioned but belongs to the industrial door range, where tooling and production investments are already sunk and early results can still be read as a ramp-up.
The insulated glazed variant supports the firm's thermal-solution positioning, and with little public exposure it carries some drop risk, though not enough to abandon it after one year.
Its dedicated web page signals public commitment and strategic centrality within the industrial door line, making withdrawal costly to justify.
